gate_criteria.description: API/Core/worker and native artifacts can be built and released independently under schema/protocol compatibility and evidence gates
verified_points: Independent CI/CD pipelines producing immutable release manifests for API, Core, and worker services.
Cryptographic source candidate attestation with pinned commit SHAs, reproducible artifact hashes, and SLSA-aligned metadata.
Explicit schema compatibility matrix verifying forward/backward compatibility across n-1 and n+1 deployments.
Rollback policy enforced: rollback redeploys previous compatible container digests; downward database migration strictly prohibited.
Trusted release signing workflows separate from public development builds; zero token or key leakage.
